description: Returns, for a company outside the US, whether it is in the global LEI register (GLEIF): legal name, country, local registry number, whether it is active and its ultimate parent. For a US company, returns the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau complaint record (counts, top problems, on-time answers, how often people got relief) and whether it is an FDIC-insured bank, and for a public company what it reported to the SEC (EDGAR XBRL): revenue, net income and diluted EPS for four fiscal years, the latest quarter against a year earlier, cash and shares outstanding, additional annual financial metrics, up to eight reported quarters, company profile and recent filings. The input is a name or a US ticker such as NVDA. Complaint counts grow with company size. Applies to questions about what public records show about a company. Not investment advice. Stock prices are not included.

company.description: Company name or US stock ticker, e.g. 'Capital One', 'Chime', 'NVDA'

country.description: Country where the company is registered or operates; leave out for the US

months.description: How far back to count; default 24

name: check_company
title: Company: registry record, complaints and SEC filings
